novel_features.name: SQLite fleet sync
novel_features.description: Rate-limited mirror of sites, devices, clients, alerts, events, firmware, subscriptions, WLANs, and audit into local SQLite so agents stop re-hitting the account-wide 10 req/s cap.

novel_features.name: Fleet brief
novel_features.description: One local rollup: down devices, critical alerts, firmware drift, subscriptions inside the window, and worst sites.

novel_features.name: Mirror export
novel_features.description: Dump the SQLite mirror as one JSON document or a directory of CSV files for agent ingest.

novel_features.name: Credential doctor
novel_features.description: Exit non-zero with a JSON error naming CENTRAL_BASE_URL, CENTRAL_CLIENT_ID, and CENTRAL_CLIENT_SECRET when any is missing. Rejects Classic Central hosts.
